build: staging as promoted 2026-09-20 (#599): the D1 Swapper panel, before #612/#613
browser: Chrome on Linux, driven through the Claude in Chrome extension
viewport: 1536x904 CSS px at devicePixelRatio 1.25; the window could not be resized to 1440x1600, and panel shots are cropped to the panel
flow: Receive (XLM) -> Swap (XLM -> USDC, 1% slippage, 300 s deadline) -> Pay (USDC)

findings.09-focus: The slippage field reached by Shift+Tab, Tab matches :focus-visible and shows the browser's default outline only; the app's own border stays #27272a (no BRAND focus style). The focused canvas node shows no visible focus indicator.
findings.11-same-asset: The message renders under Asset Out, but no control carries aria-invalid or aria-describedby and the panel has no live region, so the error is not announced.
findings.12-router: A disabled <select> with one option, 'Soroswap (testnet)'; the router contract id is not shown.
findings.14-keyboard: The Swap node is reachable by Tab (18 presses from page load, via the edges); Enter and Space do not open the panel; after opening it with a click, Escape does not close it, and the panel has no Close button.

notCaptured.13-phone: The Chrome window could not be narrowed below its maximised size, so the Pixel 7 (412 px) shot is left to the manual phone check in #614.
